rationale:
Retain the tested incumbent program_20 unchanged as the candidate for an independent paired generation comparison, provisionally rather than as a validated optimum. Its adaptive discovery mean_pic50_delta is +0.230299, with valid-rate change +0.01 and reported MMFF-relief median/p90 0.476946/0.954550. Program_3 is nearly tied in mean (+0.229293) but has p90 1.252575. Program_4 has higher best-valid affinity but valid-rate change -0.02 and slightly larger relief median/p90. Program_19 offers a smaller relief p90 (0.907866) and stronger window-shape improvement at a lower mean (+0.212839); program_8 offers lower relief median/p90 at a lower mean (+0.139001). These competing outcomes do not demonstrate an affinity-preserving, strain-improving replacement under the task priorities. The discovery records lack independent paired uncertainty and all-attempt tail denominators.

The coordinate observable is complete native FLOWR endpoint forecast Y_t in world-coordinate A, compared with the registered endpoint teachers at the same exact learned node. Retain program_path configs/experiments/ck2_affinity_geometry30_v1/backtrack_round26.json (SHA256 7a0455c943619ae5a07e29590859ee14a2eaecd92a1accbea98389512015cce6) and endpoint_reference.json.gz (registered SHA256 d706173b74a937c5becac08ccbcff187f48e50ca3303d9021667e466fa5fb77c). In the supplied endpoint_pointcloud formula, detach Hungarian squared-distance correspondence and nearest-teacher choice, retain K=4 and q_m=mean_i ||Y_t,i-teacher_m,assignment(i)||^2, and use R=0.5*logsumexp_m(log(pi_m)-rho_2(q_m)/0.5), with rho_delta(q)=delta^2*(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1). The detached registered prior uses endpoint cost temperature 4.0 A2 and teacher_score_beta=2.0; retain any existing optional base-weight behavior. These scalar values and robust_delta=2 come from the historical program, not an empirical optimum inferred from feature effects. Whole-cloud alternatives remain distinct inside logsumexp rather than being replaced with an independently averaged feature target. The information audit supports testing preservation of geometry: sparse choices have 0.081 A excess fixed RMS and top4 overlap 0.470, but their higher score correlation prevents claiming that full matching has already shown an affinity advantage.

Observed global and landmark-00 associations motivate geometry as a candidate target without prescribing new directions. Regional overlap, common global spread changes and node sign changes leave incremental benefit of spatial reweighting unresolved, so retain global matching. All audited fitted Legendre curves fail their runtime certificate; use exact supported reference nodes, not those fitted directions. The isolated corrected landmark-00 increment association and uncorrected survival suggestions do not establish a beneficial history penalty or justify replacing endpoint teachers with terminal-credit teachers. Generation-clock feature increments are not spatial reward gradients or physical velocities.

Use g_t=J_FLOWR_endpoint(X_t)^T*grad_Y R through the existing native forward graph. Retain native_rms_ratio=0.33 relative to predictive flow, time_ramp_power=0, registered clipping and bounded backtracking (max_atom_step_A=0.15, backtrack_attempts=7, max_cumulative_rms_A=6.0). Nearby historical dose settings do not supply an independently estimated optimum or evidence that more guidance is better; normalized gradient scaling alone would not diagnose delivered dose. Apply only exact learned clocks 0.00 through 0.49 within the registered [0,0.5] window, then native continuation. Preserve zero additional production forward calls, no affinity-head gradient, no SMC and no graph veto.

Validation hypotheses: in independent batches with paired starting conditions, this retained complete-geometry candidate maintains or improves final predicted affinity while strain does not materially regress. Report all attempts and failures, validity, affinity means and physical median/tails with their denominators and batch-level uncertainty separately. Confirm actual delivered displacement, clipping/backtracking and reward response before diagnosing insufficient dose. The strain materiality margin and relief units/definitions must be specified for the comparison; they are absent from the supplied evidence, so no non-regression claim is made here.
failure_modes: Adaptive reuse and observational selection can exaggerate apparent affinity benefit; the incumbent's tiny mean advantage is not an independently established difference.
The detached teacher prior may favor score noise or an unsupported conformation; retaining complete clouds and a mixture does not prove that distinct beneficial modes have been resolved.
Hungarian correspondence and nearest-teacher membership can switch discontinuously. Locally differentiable pointcloud attraction does not establish chemical compatibility or a residue mechanism.
Normalized guidance and clipping/backtracking can alter delivered displacement; reward scaling or larger nominal dose may leave the update unchanged or worsen affinity/strain.
Overlapping regional/global patterns, changing exact-node signs, failed fitted curves and sparse lineage coverage can produce misleading regional, history or terminal-credit targets.

Endpoint forecasts can improve the reward without improving final quality. Affinity means can conceal invalid attempts or worsening physical tails, and the supplied relief summaries lack a material non-regression margin and complete denominators.

Interpolation or continuation beyond the observed exact nodes would exceed learned support; native continuation is required outside it. A changed graph alone does not demonstrate the mechanism of quality loss.
